# Positive ordered-list fixtures

This directory contains Slice 4.3 programs for ordered homogeneous lists,
empty contextual lists, nested lists, nullable elements, and closed list
defaults containing contextual records.

Within the ecosystem these immutable sources connect list grammar and limits to
logical IR ordering, fingerprints, reader validation, probe summaries, and
Stage 4 conformance evidence.
